core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Kaab corresponds to the Arabic form كعب (Arabic كَعْب (Kaʿb)). Its core sense is ka'b; a male given name. Kaab is Arabic كَعْب (Kaʿb), a well-documented male given name borne by Ka'b ibn Malik, a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The source gloss 'A grave, tomb, or burial place' is unsupported; the name is a proper name.
